posts.caption:
Beloveds, it’s time.

After a sold-out winter show, Drag Church is returning to the sanctuary for a night of release and rebuilding with REBIRTH.

Tickets are LIVE at bit.ly/dragchurch-rebirth 
Grab yours before they’re gone. 💥

REBIRTH is a full-scale revival that blends queer art, activism, and radical joy and reminds us that…

Transformation doesn’t always arrive gently.
Sometimes it feels like unraveling.
Like the necessary crumbling of what can no longer hold us.

This event is rooted in the belief that new beginnings require release. Release of old stories, structures, and ways of being that no longer serve us. Through electrifying drag performances, a guided meditation, and intentional communal participation, we explore the truth that breaking is not failure. The truth that some things must break before a better foundation can be built.

A curated lineup of unforgettable artists @bjblessings @thebrandi_marx @jizzuhbelljohnson @kara.sutra and @sid_seedy will deliver performances that guide the evening through moments of rejoice, rejuvenescence, and release. 

Throughout the night, we’ll gather in reflection, asking:

What are you ready to release?
What is asking to be rebuilt?
What kind of future can we create together?

REBIRTH invites you to envision something brand new and nurture the seeds of liberation, build deeper community connections, and co-create the world we wish existed.

This spiritually inclusive, family-friendly gathering also features a fundraiser supporting Lambert House and investing directly in LGBTQ+ youth in our region.

📍 Event Details

📅 April 4, 2026
⏰ Doors 6:30 PM | Show 7:30 PM
📍 7400 Woodlawn Ave NE, Seattle

🎫 Tickets bit.ly/dragchurch-rebirth

$25 General Admission (first come/first seated)
$50 VIP (Front 2 rows of traditional church pews, a gift, & signed poster by the cast)
Limited Pay-What-You-Can tickets available
🏩 Donate to Lambert House and receive a poster signed by our cast
